findings.before: Lifetime defined; recovery of unexpired Secrets across crashes not specified.
findings.after: Loss of unexpired Secrets on crash/restart permitted; lifetime is a maximum, not durability; no recovery offered.

findings.before: Opening could reveal immediately or require a separate action.
findings.after: Neutral page on opening; explicit Show action required; optional code still required; no preview disclosure.

findings.before: New disclosure vs new authorization at expiry; offline/resume and in-flight behavior not fixed.
findings.after: Service-owned time; check just before release; no release at/after expiry; client suppresses late display, hides locally offline, rechecks before redisplay on resume. Concurrent pre-expiry reads allowed; previously acquired plaintext or ciphertext/keys cannot be revoked.
findings.approval: User approved boundary clarification and final in-flight/offline rule.

findings.before: 64 KiB Secret text lacked byte accounting.
findings.after: Sum of UTF-8 address/login/password-or-key text before encryption, excluding code and packaging; preserve credential text exactly.

findings.before: Omitted password/key did not distinguish empty from whitespace-only.
findings.after: Reject missing or whitespace-only password/key; preserve all whitespace in nonempty values without trimming/normalization.

findings.before: Twelve characters and random generation lacked matching/count/generation rules.
findings.after: At least12 Unicode code points; exact case-and-space-sensitive match without trimming/normalization; generated code20 Latin letters/digits, secure randomness.

findings.before: Ten successful creations per minute could mean calendar or rolling window.
findings.after: At most10 successful creations per network address in any rolling60 seconds; reject without link, preserve current draft, explain waiting.

findings.before: Wrong-code/corruption behavior and temporary attempt controls not fully defined.
findings.after: No partial disclosure or permanent link consumption on wrong code; exact attempts/delays/error distinctions deferred.
findings.approval: Easy assumptions ledger, item6 approved for defer.

findings.before: Retry following lost creation response could create duplicates or leave success uncertain.
findings.after: No success claim without confirmed link or silent lifetime extension; duplicate/safe-retry/unreachable-Secret cleanup policy deferred under existing retention limits.
findings.approval: Easy assumptions ledger, item7 approved for defer.

subsequent_decisions.current_rule: Minimum six arbitrary Unicode code points; exact matching and twenty-character generation retained; see edits-log.json
Full minute-level range retained; exact hour-snapping interaction deferred to screens
